decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - Details of the handrails and the metal coping to be brickwork shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval given

Condition : 5 - The colour of the proposed brickwork is considered unsatisfactory in the form shown on the drawings submitted to date and this aspect of the scheme should be modified to ensure an acceptable form of development. Sample panels of London Stock bricks showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced.
Condition : 6 - The basement] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 37 Hartington Road.
description: Following approval for demolition of part of rear extension and erection of part single and part two storey and erection of part 3 storey incorporating alterations to the basement details submitted pursuant to Condition 2 (amended plans) of permission 00567/37/P12 approved 06/12/2002.
